claims.claim: Clean and Sharp UK Used Canon EOS D650 DSLR Camera
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Canon DSLR body and an 18–55mm lens, but no clear evidence of overall cleanliness/optical sharpness.
No photo/video evidence of shutter operation, autofocus performance, or sensor/IBIS status; LCD text is not readable.
Witness report shows lens barrel markings with 18–55 visible.
Witness identity section names Canon EOS 650D and reads it from Photo 0.

risks.risk: Unconfirmed functionality (shutter, autofocus, exposure, sensor health).
risks.proof: Short video or test shots showing autofocus lock on a subject + a sample image at multiple apertures, plus a screen showing shutter count (or a clear camera info screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used camera that may be untested/possibly faulty until a working test is shown.

risks.risk: Lens condition unknown (fungus/haze, scratches, focus smoothness).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lens elements (front and rear) under light, plus a focus test video (rack focus) and a sharpness sample shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for lens issues (as-is, possible haze/scratches).

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear not fully visible (scratches/dents/cracked screen or worn grips).
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of the body front/back/edges and a clear LCD screen photo showing no dead pixels/lines.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average-worn condition if damage is not clearly ruled out.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card, box).
risks.proof: Photo spread showing every included item laid out and labeled, including battery model, charger, both lens caps, strap, and memory card.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera + lens only (no accessories) until the full bundle is confirmed.

risks.risk: Unclear lens variant (IS vs non-IS) and exact model beyond 18–55 range.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens label/side text showing the exact lens model (e.g., IS markings) and mount details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the least desirable common 18–55 variant until IS/variant is confirmed.

proof_requests: Provide a short video showing the camera powering on, focusing on a moving subject, and taking a clear test photo (preferably indoors and outdoors).
Show close-up photos of the lens front and rear elements under bright light to check for fungus/haze/scratches.
Send a clear photo of the LCD screen with the menu visible (to confirm it’s functional and free of dead pixels/lines).
List and photograph all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, memory card, both lens caps, strap, and any box).
Photograph the lens label/side text to confirm the exact 18–55 model (especially whether it’s IS).
response.reason: The witness report reliably identifies the item as a Canon EOS 650D with an 18–55mm lens, so it can be priced at worst-case for unverified working condition and unknown lens/accessory details.
